caption: The video depicts a clear cylindrical drinking glass resting on a white tabletop against a pale gray wall. Inside, transparent liquids form stacked layers: a colorless upper band, a lens-shaped pale-yellow middle, and a colorless lower portion. A yellow-and-black striped straw slants in from the top right, its colored tip resting near the bottom-left of the glass. Crossing the liquid interfaces, the straw appears offset and kinked at each boundary, a persistent refractive illusion. The glass, straw, layer boundaries, and background hold steady positions, showing no noticeable translation, rotation, or deformation. The apparent breaks at the upper surface and the yellow-layer boundary remain in the same places, while only negligible flickering of specular highlights disturbs the still scene.
relations: The slanted straw crossing the liquid interfaces -> persistent apparent offsets and kinks at each boundary, unchanged over time.
The glass resting steadily on the tabletop -> stacked liquid layers and straw hold fixed positions without translation or deformation.
Light reflecting off the glass and straw surfaces -> only negligible flickering of specular highlights disturbs the still scene.
